verses.text: From inside the fish, Jonah prayed to the LORD his God.
He said, “I called to the LORD in my distress, and he answered me. From deep in the grave I cried for help, and you heard my voice.
“You threw me into the depths, into the heart of the sea. Floodwaters surrounded me; all your waves and breakers swept over me.
“I said, ‘I have been driven away from your sight, but I will look again toward your holy temple.’
“The waters closed over me, threatening my life. The deep surrounded me, and seaweed wrapped around my head.
“I sank down to the roots of the mountains. The earth locked me in forever. But you brought my life up from the pit, LORD my God.
“As my life was slipping away, I remembered the LORD. My prayer reached you, into your holy temple.
“Those who cling to worthless idols abandon the mercy that could be theirs.
“But I will offer you a sacrifice with grateful praise. I will keep my vows. Salvation belongs to the LORD!”
Then the LORD spoke to the fish, and it vomited Jonah out onto dry land.
